taskDescription: Complete the crossword using key terms from PA HB1 | Hepatobiliary System. All answers are single medical/anatomical terms directly from the bilirubin metabolism pathway.

words.clue: End-product of hemoglobin breakdown that accumulates to cause yellow discoloration in jaundice
Yellow discoloration of skin and mucous membranes occurring when serum bilirubin exceeds 2.5 mg/dL
Plasma protein that reversibly binds unconjugated bilirubin for safe transport through blood
Liver cell that performs bilirubin uptake via OATP transporters and conjugation via UGT1A1
Severe neurotoxic complication resulting from free unconjugated bilirubin crossing the blood-brain barrier
Specialized hepatic blood vessel where albumin-bilirubin complexes come into contact with hepatocytes
Colorless metabolite produced by bacterial enzyme action on conjugated bilirubin in the colon
Brown pigment derived from urobilinogen that provides the characteristic color of normal stool
Green-colored intermediate produced when haem oxygenase opens the porphyrin ring
Iron-binding plasma protein that transports iron recycled from senescent red blood cell hemoglobin
